sources.title: Visa Information For Foreigners
sources.publisher: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Foreign Affairs country-by-country table directly states ordinary-passport exemptions, electronic routes, mission routes and conditions for the named nationalities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Barbados: Ordinary passport holders are required to have visa to enter Türkiye. They can obtain three month multiple entry e-Visas.

sources.title: Visa information for Indian passport holders visiting Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy of India in Ankara page, updated 17 August 2026, directly gives the ordinary Indian-passport entry requirement for Türkiye.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Indian passport holders shall be required to have an electronic visa or a sticker visa issued by a Turkish diplomatic or consular mission abroad.

policies.title: Barbadian, Grenadian and Jamaican ordinary-passport visitor eVisas
policies.summary: Türkiye MFA’s current country row directly provides the electronic visitor-visa route for the named ordinary-passport cohort.
conditions: Ordinary passport; short visitor travel only.
The MFA directly says each nationality may obtain a three-month multiple-entry eVisa via evisa.gov.tr.
Work, study, residence, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: South African ordinary-passport visitor eVisa
policies.summary: Türkiye MFA’s current country row directly provides the electronic visitor-visa route for the named ordinary-passport cohort.
conditions: Ordinary passport; short visitor travel only.
The MFA states a one-month single-entry eVisa is available online; it separately permits a three-month multiple-entry visa from Turkish representations.
Work, study, residence, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Surinamese and Vietnamese ordinary-passport visitor eVisas
policies.summary: Türkiye MFA’s current country row directly provides the electronic visitor-visa route for the named ordinary-passport cohort.
conditions: Ordinary passport; short visitor travel only.
The MFA directly provides a 30-day single-entry electronic visa for each named nationality.
Work, study, residence, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Bhutanese and Nepali ordinary-passport visitor visas from Turkish missions
policies.summary: Türkiye MFA’s current rows directly make ordinary Bhutanese and Nepali visitors obtain short visas from Turkish diplomatic or consular missions abroad.
conditions: Ordinary passport; short visitor travel only.
The MFA gives ordinary Bhutanese and Nepali passport holders a 15-day visa route from Turkish diplomatic or consular missions abroad.
The separate Nepal eVisa option requires a qualifying Schengen, USA, UK or Ireland visa or residence permit and is not the passport-wide baseline.
Work, study, residence, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Indian ordinary-passport Türkiye pre-travel visa baseline
policies.summary: Current Indian Embassy guidance says Indian passport holders must hold either a qualifying eVisa or a sticker visa issued by a Turkish diplomatic or consular mission before entering Türkiye.
conditions: Ordinary passport; short visitor travel only.
The Turkish eVisa is conditional on a valid qualifying Schengen, USA, UK or Ireland visa or residence permit; that supporting-document alternative is not the baseline.
The stated alternative sticker visa is issued by a Turkish diplomatic or consular mission abroad; visa on arrival is not available.
Work, study, residence, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

unresolved.reason: Türkiye MFA makes ordinary Algerian entry age-dependent: under 15 and over 50 are visa-exempt; ages 15–50 require a visa, with eVisa only for specified ages holding qualifying documents. No passport-wide status is normalized.
Türkiye MFA says Cambodian ordinary-passport holders require a visa but gives no direct ordinary-passport issuance channel. The eVisa portal is not used as eligibility or timing evidence.

Türkiye MFA makes Egyptian ordinary-passport eVisa availability age- and condition-dependent: under 15 or over 45 may use eVisa, while ages 15–45 need qualifying documents and named airlines. No passport-wide status is normalized.

Türkiye MFA makes Libyan ordinary-passport entry age-dependent: under 16 and over 45 are visa-exempt; ages 16–45 require a visa and only qualifying-document holders may use eVisa. No passport-wide status is normalized.

Türkiye MFA makes Iraqi ordinary-passport entry age-dependent: under 15 and over 50 are visa-exempt; ages 15–50 require a visa and only qualifying-document holders may use eVisa. No passport-wide status is normalized.
